recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed unless a future build reintroduces the obsolete generated Profiles-page sentence.
issue_request: FHIR-40699 is Applied/Persuasive for FHIR-core VisionPrescription. It requested removal of the Profiles-page sentence "Resources of type VisionPrescription do not have extensions at the root element, but extensions MAY be present on the elements in the resource"; the final resolution removed the text from the Profile page and did not require moving it to the Extension page.
initial_application: No local git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-40699 was found. The Jira follow-up comment records that the previous text was removed and replaced by "No Profiles defined for this resource," and current source plus rendered build evidence matches that applied state.
additional_context: VisionPrescription is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini and is OO-owned, but source/fhir.ini has no active VisionPrescription entry in [profiles]. The OO Confluence VisionPrescription module page lists FHIR-40699 among VisionPrescription tickets and points to the Extension Pack extensions page, without conflicting instructions.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The obsolete sentence is absent from authoritative source and from https://build.fhir.org/visionprescription-profiles.html, while the page contains "No Profiles defined for this resource" as Jira reported.
